verdict.rationale: Azure documents a public REST API with an official reference hub. That hub covers authenticating requests by registering a client app with Microsoft Entra ID, calling the API directly with curl in unattended scripts, and using client libraries for most services. Service-specific APIs such as the Cost Management APIs are also documented. The probe's 404s for OpenAPI files at guessed learn.microsoft.com paths only show no spec at those locations; they do not contradict the documented REST API. Missing for 10: a discoverable machine-readable OpenAPI spec at the probed paths, and independent hands-on corroboration of driving Azure via the REST API (community praise is about CLI scripting, not the API).
